notes: Confluence Cloud for Slack page notifications (page published, page updated, comment added). Layout mirrors the Jira Cloud card fidelity rules: (1) a mrkdwn activity line ('<who> published a page in <space>'); (2) the page title is a bold mrkdwn LINK in a `section` (NOT a header block) — point it at a REAL page in jenniferhynes.atlassian.net/wiki; (3) a short excerpt; (4) action buttons (View page / Comment / Watch / Share); (5) a context footer 'Added by Confluence Cloud'. Post via send_app_notification.py --app confluence --example <name> --ticket-url <real page url>.

examples.name: page_published
examples.when: A new page (PRD, RFC, runbook) is published in a watched space.

text.text: :page_facing_up:  *Alexandra French* published a page in *Software Development*

*<https://your-site.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SD/pages/1|Product Requirements: New Feature>*
